title: Your intelligence.
Made operational.
description: Specialist CTI, knowledge engineering and security automation consultancy. Start with a concrete bottleneck; build a workflow your team can understand, validate and use.

offerings.title: Cyber threat intelligence consultancy
offerings.problem: Your analysts have the reports and feeds. Turning them into structured, usable intelligence still takes too much manual work.
offerings.approach: We assess the workflow, define the information model and engineer the agreed pipeline. AI CTI Extractor capabilities can support unstructured-to-structured processing, with validation and analyst review matched to the use case.

offerings.title: Security knowledge engineering
offerings.problem: Your data sources describe the same environment in different ways. The important relationships are difficult to query and reuse.
offerings.approach: We build scoped ontologies and mappings, connect observations to infrastructure and business context, and make the resulting knowledge accessible to queries, rules and AI-assisted analysis.
deliverables: RDF / OWL ontologies and semantic mappings
Evidence, provenance and AI retrieval design

offerings.title: Playbooks, orchestration and integrations
offerings.problem: Your team knows how to respond, but operational knowledge is hard to execute consistently across disconnected tools.
offerings.approach: We design interoperable playbooks and integrations, drawing on CACAO and NSOAR capabilities. Each engagement defines the supported actions, approval rules, validation and operational handover.

process.title: Find the bottleneck.
process.text: Map the decision or action that needs to improve, the systems involved and the manual work being done today.

process.title: Agree a deliverable.
process.text: Define a bounded pipeline, knowledge model, integration or workflow, with clear scope and acceptance criteria.

process.title: Validate and hand over.
process.text: Test against agreed examples, document limitations and give your team the information needed to operate the result.

example.label: ILLUSTRATIVE ENGAGEMENT
example.title: From a threat report to reviewed intelligence.
example.description: An analyst receives reports that must be entered into OpenCTI by hand. A focused CTI engagement could connect report intake, structured extraction and analyst review.

steps.title: Agree the input
steps.text: Select a report format, a redacted sample and the entities your analysts need to capture.

steps.title: Build the workflow
steps.text: Map the information to STIX, validate the output and add a review step before import into OpenCTI.

steps.title: Hand over the result
steps.text: Receive the agreed mappings, configured pipeline, sample validation results and operating notes.

example.acceptance: Agree acceptance criteria around the sample reports, required fields, validation rules and analyst review before work starts.
